_about: Settings for San Francisco's Routes page (engine/routes/: build.py, page.html), at /sf/routes/: pick a stop near you, see where each Muni bus and Muni Metro line from it goes. Muni Metro's lines come from raw/surface/rapid_*.json (surface.json 'rapid'), their stops in order. BART isn't a route here (it's another agency's feed); its stations are connections, with Muni Metro's.
_gridTilt: San Francisco's grids disagree (north of Market they run true north, south of Market they're turned 45 degrees), so directions are read from true north.
_platformDirs: Muni names its subway platforms Outbound and Downtown (inbound); Central Subway platforms say Northbound and Southbound.
_regions: The map's five parts of the city: Downtown, the Northside, the West Side, Central and the Southeast.

stations._skip: muni_stations also lists some street stops (Church St & 16th St); only stations count as connections, keeping 4th St & King St (Caltrain) and 4th & Brannan.

page.title: Where does this line or route go?
page.description: Find the Muni bus, streetcar, cable car and Muni Metro stops nearest you in San Francisco and see where each route goes, with live next-bus and next-train times: the neighborhoods it passes through, the main streets it runs along, its BART and Muni Metro connections and the landmarks on the way.
page.lede: Find the stops near you, then pick a Muni bus, the F streetcar, a cable car or a Muni Metro line to see where it goes: the neighborhoods, main streets, connections and landmarks along the way.
page.outside: That spot is outside San Francisco. Try an address in the city.
page.noMatch: No match in San Francisco for “{q}”. Try the full street name, like “1 Ferry Building”.
page.noStops: No stops within {r} of that spot.
page.credits: Routes, stops and timetable: SFMTA (Muni) GTFS via DataSF · Neighborhoods: City and County of San Francisco (DataSF) · Streets: © OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL) · Live times: SFMTA via 511.org · BART stations: BART

badges._about: Route badge colours for apps (the web page takes them from factsheet.css): buses white with a Muni red outline, express blue, owl-only white with a navy outline; Muni Metro lines as round bullets in the line's colour, BART lines as plain dots.

_near: Stations within 200 m of a route count as connections: Mission Street's buses run a block from the BART stations under Market Street.
